<script>
(function(){
  function fmt(c){return '\u20ac' + (c/100).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');}
  function fixQb(){
    var act = null;
    document.querySelectorAll('.qb-wrapper').forEach(function(w){
      if(w.dataset.allowCustomPricing !== 'true') return;
      w.querySelectorAll('.qb-option').forEach(function(o){
        var n = o.dataset.option;
        var p = parseFloat(w.dataset['qb'+n+'CustomPrice'] || 0);
        var c = parseFloat(w.dataset['qb'+n+'CustomCompare'] || 0);
        var pricingEl = o.querySelector('.qb-pricing');
        if(p > 0){
          o.dataset.finalPrice = p;
          var pe = o.querySelector('.qb-price');
          if(pe && pe.textContent !== fmt(p)) pe.textContent = fmt(p);
        }
        if(c > 0 && pricingEl){
          o.dataset.finalCompare = c;
          var ce = o.querySelector('.qb-compare');
          if(!ce){ce = document.createElement('div'); ce.className='qb-compare'; pricingEl.appendChild(ce);}
          if(ce.textContent !== fmt(c)) ce.textContent = fmt(c);
        }
      });
      var a = w.querySelector('.qb-option.qb-active');
      if(a) act = a;
    });
    if(act){
      var p = parseFloat(act.dataset.finalPrice || 0);
      var c = parseFloat(act.dataset.finalCompare || 0);
      if(p > 0){
        document.querySelectorAll('.main-atc-price').forEach(function(el){
          if(el.textContent !== fmt(p)) el.textContent = fmt(p);
        });
        document.querySelectorAll('[id^="sticky-atc-price-"]').forEach(function(el){
          if(el.textContent.trim() !== fmt(p)) el.textContent = fmt(p);
        });
      }
      document.querySelectorAll('.main-atc-compare-price').forEach(function(el){
        if(c > p){el.textContent = fmt(c); el.style.display = '';}
        else {el.style.display = 'none';}
      });
    }
  }
  function boot(){
    [300, 800, 1500, 2500, 4000].forEach(function(d){setTimeout(fixQb, d);});
  }
  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);}
  else {boot();}
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if(e.target.closest('.qb-option')){setTimeout(fixQb, 250); setTimeout(fixQb, 600);}
  });
  document.addEventListener('qb:state-changed', function(){setTimeout(fixQb, 100);});
})();
</script>
